claim.quote: The application of the developed method to a sample exposed at the INFN Gran Sasso surface laboratory provided the first measurement of sub-MeV environmental neutrons

name: Environmental sub-MeV neutron measurement at the Gran Sasso surface laboratory with a super-fine-grained nuclear emulsion detector

summary.plain: Using its super-fine-grained emulsion as a neutron detector, NEWSdm made the first measurement of low-energy environmental neutrons at the Gran Sasso surface laboratory, a background for dark matter searches.
summary.technical: Nano Imaging Tracker emulsion with topological analysis of proton recoils; scanning speed 250 g/year/machine; 880 keV neutron calibration; first measurement of sub-MeV environmental neutrons at the INFN Gran Sasso surface laboratory.

title: Environmental sub-MeV neutron measurement at the Gran Sasso surface laboratory with a super-fine-grained nuclear emulsion detector
why_it_matters: The abstract notes that neutrons are often an irreducible background for dark matter searches.
